project.title: Cross-Channel Customer Experience Upgrade for Retail Network
project.objective: Design and roll out a unified customer experience playbook across stores, contact centre, and field sales to increase satisfaction and standardise service.
deliverables: Unified customer experience playbook for all channels
Standard in-store merchandising and cleanliness checklist
Contact centre call handling and escalation guidelines
Field sales and account management visit script and follow-up process
Training sessions and quick-reference job aids for frontline staff
Simple reporting template for customer feedback and issues
constraints: Playbook must be usable by staff with limited digital tools on-site
All materials must comply with consumer protection and data privacy rules
Rollout must be achievable within existing staffing levels and shifts
Training time per worker limited to 2 hours total during the project
Reporting templates must be simple enough for manual completion
Changes must not require new IT systems or software purchases

risks.risk: Frontline staff do not adopt the new playbook consistently.
risks.mitigation: Involve representatives from each role in design, run short practical trainings, and add simple checklists to daily routines.

risks.risk: Playbook is too complex for busy peak hours in stores and contact centre.
risks.mitigation: Pilot with a small group, remove low-value steps, and focus on 3–5 key behaviours per channel.

risks.risk: Customer data is recorded inconsistently across channels.
risks.mitigation: Define a minimal common data set and provide a single-page reporting template with examples.

risks.risk: Account managers and store staff have conflicting priorities for promotions.
risks.mitigation: Agree on a shared prioritisation rule for offers and document it in the playbook before rollout.

themes.why_relevant: All roles interact with customers; aligning greetings, needs analysis, and closing improves experience.
Sales assistants and food service workers impact how products are displayed and cleanliness is perceived.
The contact centre supervisor must align scripts with in-store and account management processes.
Sales account managers and specialised sellers need a shared approach to follow-up and aftersales.
All channels must log issues and suggestions in a consistent, lightweight way.
New routines must fit into existing shifts and be easy to remember and apply.

backlog.task: Map current customer journey across store, contact centre, and field sales
definition_of_done: Key touchpoints listed for each channel
Pain points and gaps identified from each role's perspective
Simple journey diagram added to the project doc

backlog.task: Draft unified customer experience playbook outline
definition_of_done: Sections defined for store, contact centre, and field sales
Core behaviours and tone of voice described
Outline reviewed by at least one sales account manager and one specialised seller

backlog.task: Create in-store merchandising and cleanliness checklist
definition_of_done: Checklist covers displays, stock levels, and cleanliness zones
Checklist can be completed in under 5 minutes
Pilot feedback from one crop production worker and one specialised seller incorporated

backlog.task: Define contact centre call flow and escalation rules
definition_of_done: Standard greeting, needs analysis, and closing steps documented
Clear rules for when to escalate to store or account manager
Call flow fits on a single-page guideline

backlog.task: Design field sales visit script and follow-up template
definition_of_done: Visit script includes discovery, proposal, and closing steps
Follow-up template for commitments and next steps created
Script validated with specialised seller for retail relevance

backlog.task: Align cross-channel policy for refunds and complaints
definition_of_done: Common rules for refunds and complaints drafted
Contact centre and store procedures aligned
Examples of typical cases added to the guideline

backlog.task: Create simple customer feedback reporting sheet
definition_of_done: Sheet includes date, channel, issue type, and customer comment
Usable on paper and in a basic spreadsheet
Tested by at least one person from each role

backlog.task: Prepare quick-reference job aids for frontline staff
definition_of_done: Job aids summarise 3–5 key behaviours per channel
Formats suitable for back-of-house or desk posting
Reviewed by contact centre supervisor and sales account manager

backlog.task: Plan and schedule short training sessions per channel
definition_of_done: Training agenda for each role created
Sessions scheduled within shift constraints
Attendance tracking approach defined

backlog.task: Define metrics and simple weekly reporting routine
definition_of_done: 3–4 basic indicators selected (e.g. complaints, compliments)
Weekly reporting format agreed
Responsibilities for updating reports assigned

backlog.task: Validate playbook and materials with a small pilot group
definition_of_done: Pilot run with at least one store and one account
Feedback collected using the reporting sheet
List of adjustments agreed and documented

backlog.task: Finalise and sign off unified customer experience playbook
definition_of_done: All sections updated after pilot feedback
Stakeholders confirm readiness for rollout
Final version stored and shared with all roles

threads_plan.thread_goal: Align on current customer journey and main pain points across channels.
threads_plan.trigger: Kickoff message asking everyone to share how customers currently experience each channel.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Agree on 3–4 key customer pain points to prioritise in the playbook.
Confirm the high-level customer journey map to use for the project.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Define the structure and core behaviours of the unified playbook.
threads_plan.trigger: Contact centre supervisor shares first outline of the playbook for feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Approve the main sections and format of the playbook.
Select 3–5 core behaviours that must be common across all channels.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Agree on in-store checklist, refunds policy, and job aids content.
threads_plan.trigger: Food service worker posts draft checklist and asks for store-side feedback.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Sign off on the final version of the merchandising and cleanliness checklist.
Approve the cross-channel refunds and complaints policy wording.

threads_plan.thread_goal: Plan pilot, training sessions, and feedback collection approach.
threads_plan.trigger: Contact centre supervisor proposes pilot scope and training schedule.

mandatory_decisions.decision: Choose pilot locations and participants for each role.
Agree on training schedule and weekly reporting routine for the pilot.

channel_rituals: Daily async check-in where each role posts one quick customer insight or issue seen.
Twice-weekly progress update on tasks and artifacts linked to the backlog.
Weekly review of customer feedback log and agreement on any quick fixes.
Post-pilot mini-retrospective to capture what worked and what needs adjustment.
End-of-project summary thread linking final playbook and checklists.
